[[Category:Production| ]]
'''Production management''' is the process of organising different resources to optimise [[production]].

== Optimisation criteria ==

* Productivity (amount produced in given time)
* Responsiveness (capability of responding to changing demands)
* Resource efficiency
** Energy
** Raw material
** Labour
* Output quality
* Environmental footprint
** Natural
** Social/Human

== Production strategies ==

<div class=center>
{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Strategy
! Essence
! Application
! Advantage
! Disadvantage
|-
| Make-to-order
| Produce after receiving order
| Simple products rapid to produce/Services requiring minimal preparation, of irregular demand
| No storage, respond to specific demands of client
| Less reactive: slower to deliver
|-
| Make-to-stock
| Produce and store products according to demand forecast
| Products of predictable demand/longer production cycle
| Availability on demand
| Storage cost, potential waste for perishables if demand less than forecasted
|-
| Delayed differentiation
| Make-to-stock semi-finished products, then make-to-order finished products once orders arrive
| Complex composite products of predictable overall demand, but unclear demand for each variant (e.g., bicycles)
| Combining the advantages of make-to-order and make-to-stock
| More complexity to manage, requires identification of clear, stockable intermediary products ready to be transformed into final products
|}
</div>
